When she opens the delivery app, she notices the same restaurant offers a smaller family deal for £6 less, at £6. She chooses the cheaper option, saving £6. The kids still get their favourite chicken and chips, and Maria feels a small wave of relief, she managed to treat them while staying sensible with her money.
